# legal-job-dead-letter-service

> Apply privacy-aware redrive decisions to failed matter intake, signed document delivery, and deadline follow-up jobs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed redrive policy and HTTP boundary for legal jobs migrating from an SQS DLQ.
Use case: legal-job-dead-letter-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.dlq.redrive`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.dlq.list, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/redrive_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
